graderOnly: Only the HTML usage guide docs/usage.html needs updating for the CSV export (README.md's layout list may optionally be refreshed); no Python file is part of the cycle's change and no Python docstring needs documentation work.

The persisted user style tony (.standards/user-styles/documenter/tony.md) covers only Python docstring conventions; it should be loaded because it is the explicit persisted selection, but its Args/Returns/Raises docstring structure does not apply to the HTML guide.

The documentation surfaces for this cycle are HTML (docs/usage.html) and possibly Markdown (README.md); the relevant technology style is styles/html.md, and styles/python.md is not relevant to any documentation being assessed or changed.

tools/convert_legacy.py and tools/test_convert_legacy.py are pre-existing, unrelated to the cycle, and use reST-style :param docstrings that differ from tony's preferred Google style; restyling them would be unrelated work.
The export implementation is plain JavaScript, matches the design, and has no material defects.

notes: Standalone fixture (not on export-documenting): the case needs an HTML usage guide and unrelated Python code, while the base's guide and scope are Markdown (docs/usage.md) and a case on a base cannot add pre-install layers. Pre-install: 50-service (plain JavaScript ESM records service, no dependencies: store, filter, auth with requireAdmin, router, GET /records, data/seed.json with a comma in record 1's title and quotes in record 3's, node:test suites), 51-converter (tools/convert_legacy.py, a stdlib Python script with reST-style docstrings that regenerates data/seed.json, and its pytest tests), 52-guide (docs/usage.html, the HTML help page, with no export section; README). Then the brownfield install. 60-context: CONTEXT.md and STATE at SCOPING for cycle export-20260924T090000Z-a7f3c1d2. 61-scope: AC-001 (admin-only filtered CSV export, RFC 4180 quoting, server-side denial before any write) and AC-002 (docs/usage.html accurately describes the export). 62-design: POST /records/export contract; AC-002 No architectural impact. 63-plan: APPROVED AUTONOMOUS plan, three steps on AC-001, AFTER_IMPLEMENTATION/NONE. 64-export: src/csv.js, src/routes/export.js, createApp options, test/export.test.js (8 tests), exports/ ignored. 65-complete: plan COMPLETE, STATE TESTING. 66-verification: COMPLETE FULL report, AC-002 pending Documenter. 67-review: COMPLETE implementation review, no findings, STATE DOCUMENTING. 68-style: tony.md, a user style covering only Python docstrings. 69-documentation: IN_PROGRESS documentation record created by an earlier, interrupted Documenter session that persisted User Style tony (AUTONOMOUS, ACTIVE_CHANGE) and assessed nothing yet.
